label: b2-binding-1
text:
Node binding-1 (11 of 12): make the agent's Claude Code run the checks of R2, R1, R3, R4, R8 (/opt/enforce/checks/R2, /opt/enforce/checks/R1, /opt/enforce/checks/R3, /opt/enforce/checks/R4, /opt/enforce/checks/R8) at Stop, in /workspace/.claude/settings.json: the project's settings, which load for the agent in /workspace and not for your own session. The hook reads the reply: last_assistant_message in the hook's input; on a violation it should decision "block" with the check's message (a filter gives the fixed text in it): the agent writes the reply again. Block only the violation, so the agent can fix its work and go on.
Done when: `/opt/enforce-harness/try --check` reports nothing, and /workspace/.claude/settings.json has hooks at at Stop that run /opt/enforce/checks/R2, /opt/enforce/checks/R1, /opt/enforce/checks/R3, /opt/enforce/checks/R4, /opt/enforce/checks/R8. The harness checks this when you reply.
